name: manual_188871
claim: During branch reanchor or merge conflict resolution, if one side has a real literal (LAN IP, workstation path, personal email used as an infra detail) and the other side has a placeholder or redacted form of the same value, always keep the redacted side regardless of which side is otherwise 'newer' or 'more detailed' -- a security redaction must never be silently reverted by a content merge.

decisions.notes: 2026-08-09 PT branch reanchor: a stale branch's copy of alphaclaw-session/SKILL.md had a real LAN IP hardcoded in 6+ places; origin/main had already redacted every one of them to placeholder tokens. Confirmed by diffing conflict hunks directly rather than assuming version-number recency implied content correctness -- version number alone would have pointed the same direction here, but that's not the generalizable signal; the redaction status is.
